rules: P2 DECISION-AUTHORITY.md §3 A1-A9 with the §5 v0.2 changes C1-C5

decisions.statement: The payment-terms decision in force is DEC-B12 (21 days; supersedes DEC-B01), so a quote is payable 21 days after today. This matches the requirement's example (2026-03-02 + 21 = 2026-03-23).

Invoice issuing is left on the existing 30-day rule (Rules.dueDate, DEC-B01). BILL-41 requires existing behaviour to be unchanged except as its requirements say, and tests/Billing.Tests/BaseTests.fs pins 30 days. The DEC-B12 term is added to Rules as a separate rule (revisedPaymentTermDays / payableBy) used only by quotes. Whether invoicing should move to DEC-B12 is left as an open question, not decided.

A quote amount is validated with the existing Commands.parseAmount (positive, at most two decimals) and is checked before the customer, as the invoice command does; usage errors come from the existing help-line lookup.
help lists 'quote <customer> <amount>' directly after the invoice line; the README command list is updated to match.
